title: 用户注册系统
problem_statement_md:
你正在为网站编写用户注册系统。

用户注册时，输入的用户名应超过3个字符。
任何少于4个字符的用户名都是无效的。

完善代码，输入一个用户名，如果用户名无效，则抛出异常，输出"**Invalid Name**"。否则输出 "**Account Created**"。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Registration System[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are making a registration form for a website.
The form has a name field, which should be more than 3 characters long.
Any name that has less than 4 characters is invalid.
Complete the code to take the name as input, and raise an exception if the name is invalid, outputting "[b]Invalid Name[/b]". Output "[b]Account Created[/b]" if the name is valid.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
abc

[b]Sample Output[/b]
Invalid Name 

[note]Use [b]try/raise/except[/b] statements.[/note]
